boundary.title: 臺北市區界圖
boundary.description: 行政區界之調整為本局之權責，另為推動業務上運用地理資訊，特將本市十二個行政區加以建置GIS圖層供各公務機關參考使用，本項資料所採用座標系統為TWD97。
boundary.license: 依政府資料開放授權條款-第1版

bridge.title: 臺北市橋梁資訊
bridge.description: 臺北市橋梁資訊json file格式檔案，內容包含橋梁編號、橋梁名稱、橋梁英文名稱、管理機關、轄下機關、所在縣市、所在區鄉、設計單位、監造單位、施工單位、定期檢測週期(月/次)、橋梁總長(公尺)、最大淨寬(公尺)、最小淨寬(公尺)、總車道數、點位座標等資訊。
bridge.publisher: 臺北市政府工務局新建工程處
bridge.license: 依政府資料開放授權條款-第1版

boundary.crsEvidence: Actual .prj plus official catalogue TWD97 declaration
boundary.geometryValidation: 12 unique district codes, finite projected coordinates, complete ordered records, nonzero closed rings; no repair or full topological certification

projection.primaryHypothesis: Published longitude/latitude treated as EPSG:4326, axis longitude then latitude
projection.datumComparisonLimitation: Pinned proj4 marks the retained boundary PRJ as no-datum and skips datum transformations. Comparing GRS80 and WGS84 definitions here is a no-op; zero differences would not establish robustness. No precision or datum certification.
projection.nearBoundaryBandMeaning: Sensitivity flag, not measured accuracy or exclusion threshold
limits: Official bridge catalogue has no EPSG/datum declaration.
Polygon results are conditional on a coordinate hypothesis and the retained 20220915 boundary edition.
Endpoints and administrative responsibility can legitimately cross districts.
No source district correction, identity crosswalk, structural judgment or change to original 194 eligibility.
